title: AI presentations | Local-first, agent-assisted OpenSlideX
excerpt: Use AI and agents to create editable presentations locally. OpenSlideX keeps your source close and exports HTML, MDX, and editable PPTX.
content_html:
Feedback survey

Create editable AI presentations locally.

Use AI and agents to move the work forward, then shape every slide in a local Workspace. Keep the source close and export when the presentation is ready.

Local-firstEditable sourceHTML · MDX · PPTX

View on GitHubGet started

Presentation work breaks down when ideas are scattered across tools, the source is locked away, and the final file is hard to revise. OpenSlideX keeps the whole path in one local workspace.

AI builds, you refine

Start with a clear structure, then refine every detail—from a solid 80 to a persuasive 90.

Keep the source in your hands

Every deck stays as readable MotionDoc MDX files on your computer, not trapped behind an account or cloud platform.

Deliver without losing editability

Preview locally, then export HTML, MDX, or editable PPTX for the way the work needs to travel.

Build presentations locally.

Start in a folder you own. Open Workspace when you need a canvas. Keep your source files close and stay in control.

View setup guide

Command Console

One command installs OpenSlideX as a complete local app.

No Node.js, npm, Git, or administrator access required.

Installed? Open a new terminal and run slidex

Sponsorship coming soon

Open creative tools deserve lasting support.

GitHub Sponsors is being prepared. Learn how you can support OpenSlideX when sponsorship opens.

Explore sponsorship

GitHub Sponsors is being set up.
